name: Longform to Shorts
description: Chunk a long article/transcript/URL with claude -p and extract N short-form candidates (hook + body). Saves to shorts-candidates.json.

claudeBin.description: Path to the claude CLI binary. Defaults to env CLAUDE_BIN or 'claude'.

model.description: Model id passed to claude -p (--model). Optional; uses CLI default if unset.

candidatesPath.description: Path to shorts-candidates.json output. Defaults to data/shorts-candidates.json.

chunkChars.description: Max characters per chunk fed to claude -p. Default: 6000.

maxCandidates.description: Max short-form candidates to keep across all chunks. Default: 8.

perChunk.description: How many candidates to extract per chunk. Default: 3.

timeoutMs.description: claude -p timeout per chunk in ms. Default: 120000.
